entries.note: Accepted at the office the scan names.
Accepted from abroad; one of the statuses the tracking window on www.ptt.gov.tr styles.
Sent on between offices. Abroad, the relayed foreign event comes before it, and a dispatch abroad follows it as "Yurtdışına Sevk Edildi".
Sent on within a province. "PTT İşyerine Girdi" (entered the office) or "PTT İşyerinden Çıktı" (left the office) can come before it.
Loaded onto a vehicle; one of the statuses the tracking window on www.ptt.gov.tr styles.
Followed by the reason, such as "Adreste Tanınmıyor" or "Adreste Yok/Kapalı-Haber Kağıdı Bırakıldı". Abroad, "Teslim girisiminde bulunuldu veya Teslim edilemedi (Gelen)" comes before it.
At the PTT office the scan names, after a failed delivery. The office becomes the pickup point.
Left in a Kargomat locker; one of the statuses the tracking window on www.ptt.gov.tr styles.
The office holds an item nobody collected. Seen on an item returned to the office that accepted it.
On its way back to the sender, followed by the reason, such as "Tanınmıyor".
A slash and the masked name of whoever signed for the item can follow; the adapter drops them. Abroad, "Gonderi teslim edildi (Gelen)" comes before it.
